@graph.name: Territory Matrix — Service Coverage by Place
@graph.description: The Flat Rate Movers service-coverage matrix: every place in the company footprint as a typed schema.org Place node with coordinates and branch binding (Winchester VA and Martinsburg WV), the full feature-by-service coverage table reconciled to the 34-service registry, and the place-to-place distance table (centroid distances, computed and labeled as computed; road miles only where separately researched). A national layer records the company performed-work record at state level: State nodes for the 49 states where the company has moved clients and performed job work — every state except Hawaii — published as the national table, kept separate from the branch footprint (state rows are the work record, not branch service areas). Generated from service-area.geojson and data/national-scope.json by build-coverage.js.
@graph.keywords: service coverage, territory matrix, places, branch binding, Winchester VA, Martinsburg WV, Shenandoah Valley, Eastern Panhandle, I-81, I-66, I-70, coverage matrix, place-to-place distance, The Flat Rate Movers
